PUT YOUR GAME FILES HERE
========================
Copy your original game folders into this folder - for example your whole "Full Tilt! 2" install
(the folder with Alien, Hero and Mad in it) and your "Full Tilt! Pinball" install (CADET, DRAGON, PIRATES).
Messy is fine: subfolders, extra files and the old .exe files are all ignored.

Then start FullTiltPinball.exe (or click "Scan for new game files"). Every table found is copied, with its
sounds and icon, into the tables folder and shows up as a card. Your files here are not changed or moved;
you can delete them afterwards.
